headline: The West Virginia Legislature confirms a cybersecurity incident that took down its website; it has not said whether data was taken.
summary: New incident page. Read The Record, WV MetroNews and The Dominion Post (Nov 20), each with the spokesperson's statement. Main answer Reported and answer_group hack-reported: outlets call it a cyberattack, an internal memo (as reported) called it a possible ransomware attack, and the Legislature's own words are 'cybersecurity incident'. incident_type attack. No service: the latest status report is from Nov 20, so whether it is back is an open question (q004). wvlegislature.gov could not be read (connection failure, then 503). Not read: West Virginia Watch and newsfromthestates (403). Privacy check done: the spokesperson is named only by role; the attorney named in one article is left out.
author: Research agent
